subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 7: revises sounds from weeks 1-6; initial sound differentiation; says plurals (-s, -es) of pictured objects

show.line: One or many? One cow, two cows. One box, two boxes!

rounds.prompt: One cow, two... what? Say it.
One fox, two... what? Say it.
Which one starts with the same sound as milk?
Do we add s or es? Sort the pictures.

hints: Count them. More than one? Add s or es.
Box, fox and dish add es.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Two foxes. Let me say it.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Two foxes. Fox adds es.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. One fox, two foxes!

parent_line: Can say the plural of words: cows, books, foxes, boxes.
